SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' ) WHERE RQDT.BUYER IN ('KRHYOS0033','KRHYOS0034','KRHYOS0036','KRHYOS0037','KRHYOS0043') AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND RQDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO LIKE 'MQ%' AND 0 = (SELECT count(*) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RECV_FLAG != 'GD' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG != 'Y') AND RQDT.RECV_FLAG != 'GD' ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , TO_NUMBER(RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ) , RQDT.REVISION
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PLANT, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, TO_NUMBER(F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',1),':',1)) AS UNIT_PRICE, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',1),':',2) AS MAKER_NAME, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',1),':',3) AS LEAD_TIME, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',1),':',4) AS CUR1, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',1),':',5) AS TAXCODE1, TO_NUMBER(F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',2),':',1)) AS UNIT_PRICE2, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',2),':',2) AS MAKER_NAME2, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',2),':',3) AS LEAD_TIME2, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',2),':',4) AS CUR2, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',2),':',5) AS TAXCODE2, TO_NUMBER(F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',3),':',1)) AS UNIT_PRICE3, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',3),':',2) AS MAKER_NAME3, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',3),':',3) AS LEAD_TIME3, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',3),':',4) AS CUR3, F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(QTA_RESULT,'^',3),':',5) AS TAXCODE3, ZCOMMENT FROM ( SELECT RQDT.PLANT AS PLANT , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION AS REVISION_NO , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , (SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(UNIT_PRICE ||':'|| AGENT ||':'|| LEAD_TIME ||':'|| 'KRW' ||':'|| 'VB', '^'),2)) FROM ( SELECT QT.BUYER, QT.QUOTATION_NO, QT.QUOTATION_SEQ, SUBSTRB(CP.COM_NAME_LOC,1,32) AGENT, QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, QT.LEAD_TIME, DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY QT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG DESC,QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE) RK FROM KEPQTDT QT INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY CP ON (1 = 1 AND CP.COM_CODE = QT.AGENT ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND NVL(QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) > 0 AND QT.STATUS = 'C' ORDER BY QT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG DESC, QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE ) Z START WITH Z.RK = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR Z.RK = ( Z.RK -1 ) ) AS QTA_RESULT , SUBSTR(RQDT.ATOB_REMARK,1,30) AS ZCOMMENT FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' ) F
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'E', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
